questions.question: Name the capital city of your province and two other main cities or towns in it.
questions.expected_answer: Answers depend on the learner's province, for example: North West, capital Mahikeng, with Rustenburg and Potchefstroom; or KwaZulu-Natal, capital Pietermaritzburg, with Durban and Richards Bay.

questions.question: Explain the steps to find your own settlement on a map of South Africa.
questions.expected_answer: Find your province using the borders and colours. Find its capital, marked with a star. Look for your settlement's name, or the nearest town if it is too small. Use the index and grid reference, and landmarks such as rivers and main roads.

questions.question: Write a sentence describing where you live, using four parts.
questions.expected_answer: Give the name of your settlement, your province, a big city, town or landmark nearby, and a compass direction. For example: I live in Thohoyandou, in Limpopo, north-east of Polokwane.
